query:
with targets as materialized (
 select a.id,a.slate_date,a.normalized_pitcher,a.side,a.official_book,a.locked_at,a.game_time,
 a.evaluation_proof#>>'{candidate,line_source_provider}' as provider,
 a.evaluation_proof#>>array['bindings',a.evaluation_proof#>>'{candidate,line_source_provider}','provider_event_id'] as event_id
 from public.alternative_pick_selection_state a where a.bundle_id='pregame_alternative_pick_methodology_v2' and a.checkpoint='frozen_pregame' and a.selection_status='selected' and a.slate_date between '2026-07-24' and '2026-09-03'
)
select t.id,t.slate_date,t.provider,t.event_id,
(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s)) from (
 select s.id,s.provider,s.provider_event_id,s.market_key,s.bookmaker_key,s.bookmaker_title,s.player_name,s.normalized_player_name,s.side,s.line,s.american_odds,s.observed_at,s.game_time
 from public.market_snapshots s where s.provider=t.provider and s.provider_event_id=t.event_id and s.market_key='pitcher_strikeouts' and s.normalized_player_name=t.normalized_pitcher and s.side=t.side
 and regexp_replace(lower(s.bookmaker_key),'[^a-z0-9]','','g')=regexp_replace(lower(t.official_book),'[^a-z0-9]','','g')
 and s.observed_at >= t.locked_at-interval '20 minutes' and s.observed_at<t.game_time
 order by s.observed_at,s.id limit 101
) s) as snapshots from targets t order by t.slate_date,t.id
